name: Jalan Besar Fringe
summary: Edges of Jalan Besar toward Lavender / Bendemeer — denser central living with EWL/DTL optionality and late food energy as the lifestyle tax.
body: Jalan Besar Fringe is the shortlist when central food density and dual-line adjacency matter more than quiet landed texture. The pocket sits on the Jalan Besar / Lavender / Bendemeer edges; housing mixes mid-age walk-ups and selective condo stock. Expats land here for car-light CBD hops and late options without Orchard premiums. Watch-outs: weekend noise, older-landing hydrant clearance fights, and peak interchange crowding. Compare with Farrer Park South for stadium-adjacent living, Bendemeer West for quieter NEL edges, and Lavender South when EWL mid-town wins.
